unlisted_practices: Hybrid regex-to-snippet-to-LLM extraction pipeline to reduce processing time compared with full-document LLM inference
Locally hosted open-weights LLMs so data stay within institutional environments
Auditing retrieval recall using clinician-annotated regex-negative notes
Measuring computational scalability (elapsed time, out-of-memory events, GPU temperature, energy)

screen.reason: The study develops and tests a technical pipeline (SPELL) combining regex snippet extraction and local LLMs for retrospective information extraction from EHR notes, evaluating computational efficiency and extraction accuracy.
